task.task_text: You are auditing a remittance ledger. Each line is one billed service. The amount owed for a line is qty x unit_rate. A line is UNDERPAID when paid is less than qty x unit_rate; its shortfall is (qty x unit_rate) - paid, in currency units with two decimals. Lines paid exactly, or overpaid, are not underpayments and must not be reported. Find every underpaid line.

You are auditing a remittance ledger. Each line is one billed service. The amount owed for a line is qty x unit_rate. A line is UNDERPAID when paid is less than qty x unit_rate; its shortfall is (qty x unit_rate) - paid, in currency units with two decimals. Lines paid exactly, or overpaid, are not underpayments and must not be reported. Find every underpaid line.

The ledger has 60 lines, numbered row 1 to row 60. Its columns are:
row,line_id,qty,unit_rate,paid
You will not see the rows themselves.

You coordinate 4 workers. Each worker receives only the brief you write for it and the ledger rows you assign to it, given as inclusive row ranges. Workers cannot see the task description above, each other, or any rows you do not assign to them. Their reports will then be combined into one final answer.

Write a brief for each of the 4 workers. Do not show your working or any explanation. Reply with only a JSON object:
{"workers": [{"worker": 1, "brief": "<instructions>", "ranges": [[<first row>, <last row>]]}, ...]}
